mapper.sql: mk.id as id, mk.ledger_id as ledger_id, mk.user_id as user_id, mk.category_id as category_id, mk.transaction_date as transaction_date, mk.updated_at as updated_at, c.name as category_name, mk.type as type, mk.amount as amount, mk.notes as notes
mapper.select:
select
from moneykeeper as mk left join categories as c on mk.category_id = c.id where mk.id = #{recordId} and mk.deleted_at = 0

select
from moneykeeper as mk left join categories as c on mk.category_id = c.id where mk.deleted_at = 0 and mk.category_id = #{categoryId} order by mk.updated_at desc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (name, icon, color, type, user_id, ledger_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{icon}, #{color}, #{type}, #{userId}, #{ledgerId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO moneykeeper (user_id, ledger_id, category_id, type, amount, transaction_date, notes, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{ledgerId}, #{categoryId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{transactionDate}, #{notes}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
